topics.topic: Collision policy in installed-instance checks: whether credential headers must also be rejected when they conflict with kernel-reserved headers
questions: At startup, must instance checking reject only credential-header vs required-header collisions, or also credential-header collisions with kernel-set headers (`host`, `accept-encoding`, `content-type`, `content-length`)?

topics.topic: Data source for installed-instance collision checks: how the kernel gets the full configured service/credential-header set at startup
questions: How does `bindings.check_installed_instances` obtain the complete set of configured services (and their credential header names) to check, given State 3 lists only `selected_instance_name`, `resolve_service_credential`, and `manifest_source` on `module:installation`?

topics.topic: Failure semantics for add_trial_case partial writes: handling bytes already written when record_change fails
questions: If one or more `put_value_bytes` calls succeed but the subsequent `record_change` fails, are those newly written bytes kept as unreferenced content or rolled back/cleaned up?

topics.topic: Responsibility in read-only flow for loading file input bytes (including spooled files) into POST/PUT/PATCH request construction
questions: For a `read` operation using `POST`/`PUT`/`PATCH` with `file` inputs (allowed by A09 rule 2), which module reads file bytes (including spooled files) and passes them into request construction in this flow?
